name: France
shortSummary: France is one of India's most reliable defence and strategic partners, supplying Rafale fighter jets and Scorpene submarines, and co-founding the International Solar Alliance with India.

majorAreasOfCooperation.description: Rafale jets and Scorpene submarines anchor one of India's deepest defence-industrial relationships.
ISRO and the French space agency CNES collaborate on satellite and launch technology.

recentDevelopments.title: Continued defence-industrial deepening
recentDevelopments.description: India and France continued discussions on additional Rafale acquisitions (including for the Navy) and expanded submarine and space cooperation.
recentDevelopments.whyItMatters: France remains one of India's most consistent major-power defence partners, largely insulated from the volatility seen elsewhere.

historicalEvents.title: Strategic Partnership
historicalEvents.description: India and France become one of India's earliest Strategic Partnerships, notably continuing even after India's 1998 nuclear tests.

historicalEvents.title: Scorpene Submarine Deal
historicalEvents.description: India signs a deal for six French-designed Scorpene-class submarines to be built in India under the P-75 project.

historicalEvents.title: International Solar Alliance Launched
historicalEvents.description: India and France co-launch the International Solar Alliance at the Paris climate conference (COP21).

historicalEvents.title: Rafale Fighter Jet Deal
historicalEvents.description: India signs a government-to-government deal for 36 Dassault Rafale fighter jets worth approximately €7.8 billion.
historicalEvents.impact: Significantly modernised the Indian Air Force's fighter fleet and deepened bilateral defence-industrial ties.

agreements.name: Rafale Fighter Jet Agreement
agreements.description: Procurement of 36 Rafale multirole fighter aircraft for the Indian Air Force.

agreements.name: International Solar Alliance Framework Agreement
agreements.description: India-France co-founded initiative to mobilise solar energy deployment across sun-rich nations.

defenceCooperation.name: Varuna
defenceCooperation.description: Long-running bilateral naval exercise between India and France.

defenceCooperation.name: Scorpene submarines (Project 75)
defenceCooperation.description: License-built French-designed submarines constructed at Mazagon Dock, Mumbai.

trade.majorImports: Aircraft and aircraft parts, machinery, precious stones
